panel.sample.draft_intent: Let a shopper confirm and pay for the cart on one screen: the card form on the left, the order summary on the right, and one primary action, #checkout-submit, that stays disabled until the card is valid.
panel.sample.draft_rule_1: Pressing #checkout-submit with a valid card submits the order once and shows the loading state until the bank answers.
panel.sample.draft_rule_2: A declined card shows #error-banner above the form and keeps what the shopper entered.
panel.sample.draft_rule_3: The totals update when the shipping method changes.

panel.sample.excerpt_mq: Use the primary Button only once per region.
